name: Wellesley
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Wellesley, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Wellesley, MA: holiday strolls in Wellesley Square and Linden Square, a Nutcracker, Breakfast with Santa and the tree lighting.
lede: Wellesley celebrates with holiday strolls in its shopping squares, a town tree lighting at the fire station in Wellesley Square, and Nutcrackers and Santa breakfasts nearby.
celebrates: The biggest night is the Wellesley Square Holiday Stroll, when shops along Central Street stay open late and the town lights its tree at the Wellesley Square Fire Station. Carolers fill the square, and kids follow a scavenger hunt through the stores. Linden Square adds a stroll of its own with crafts, cocoa and an animal encounter, and The Cottage serves Breakfast with Santa. Local dance schools stage Nutcrackers at Wellesley High School, Wellesley College holds Christmas Vespers in Houghton Chapel, and the Festival of Trees at Elm Bank fills Elm Bank with decorated trees.
lastyear: In 2025 the Wellesley Square Holiday Stroll took place on Sunday, December 7. The town's tree lighting ran from 5 to 5:30 pm at the Wellesley Square Fire Station at 100 Central Street, according to the Town of Wellesley calendar. The Wellesley Square merchants planned 50 carolers around the square and a scavenger hunt through participating shops, with prizes for families who completed it.
facts: Wellesley has three MBTA commuter rail stations, Wellesley Farms, Wellesley Hills and Wellesley Square. The town tree is lit outside the fire station in Wellesley Square rather than on a green. For the 2025 Holiday Stroll, the Wellesley Square merchants lined up 50 carolers to sing around the square. Elm Bank, home of the Massachusetts Horticultural Society, hosts the Festival of Trees each year, and Wellesley College's Christmas Vespers in Houghton Chapel is free to attend.
trains: Wellesley sits on the MBTA Framingham/Worcester Line, with stations at Wellesley Farms, Wellesley Hills and Wellesley Square. Wellesley Square station puts families steps from the holiday stroll, the fire station tree and the shops on Central Street. Trains run into Back Bay and South Station in Boston, so it is easy to pair a Wellesley evening with the city lights. For a holiday train ride, Edaville in Carver runs trains through its Christmas lights.

faq: Where is the Wellesley tree lighting?

The Town of Wellesley lights its tree outside the Wellesley Square Fire Station at 100 Central Street. In 2025 it was part of the Wellesley Square Holiday Stroll, with the lighting from 5 to 5:30 pm, the town calendar showed. Families can walk from the tree to the shops, carolers and the scavenger hunt in the square.
What is the Wellesley Holiday Stroll?

It is an evening in Wellesley Square when merchants open their stores, carolers sing around the square and kids follow a scavenger hunt through participating shops. The town tree lighting at the fire station happens during the stroll. Linden Square runs a separate stroll with crafts and cocoa in the Linden Street shopping center.
Is there a Nutcracker in Wellesley?

Yes. Dance schools stage Nutcracker productions at Wellesley High School, including Metrowest Dance Academy's Clara's Dream in the Katherine L. Babson Jr. Auditorium on Rice Street. Tickets are sold by the dance schools, and Metrowest's ticket page says every person, including babies, needs a ticket.
Can we take the train to Wellesley?

Yes. The MBTA Framingham/Worcester Line stops at Wellesley Farms, Wellesley Hills and Wellesley Square. Wellesley Square station is closest to the holiday stroll and the fire station tree on Central Street. Check the MBTA timetable for weekend and holiday service before you plan an evening trip.
